verses.sloka: ततो हि दुर्मना रामः श्रुत्वैवं वदतां गिरः ।दध्यौ मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।। ६.१२०.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato hi durmanā rāmaḥ śrutvaivaṁ vadatāṁ giraḥ ।dadhyau muhūrtaṁ dharmātmā bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ।। 6.120.1 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Rama, hearing the wailing of the people, whose eyes were dimmed with tears, remained for a moment.

verses.sloka: ततो वैश्रवणो राजा यमश्चामित्रकर्शनः ।सहस्राक्षो महेन्द्रश्च वरुणश्च परन्तपः ।। ६.१२०.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaścāmitrakarśanaḥ ।sahasrākṣo mahendraśca varuṇaśca parantapaḥ ।। 6.120.2 ।।

translations.english: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

verses.sloka: षडर्धनयनः श्रीमान् महादेवो वृषध्वजः ।कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः ।। ६.१२०.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍardhanayanaḥ śrīmān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ।kartā sarvasya lokasya brahmā brahmavidāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.120.3 ।।

translations.english: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.
translations.hindi: वे सब बारंबार रोकी जाने पर भी, मृतवत्सा गाय की तरह शोकपीडित हो, सिर के बाल खोले, भूमि पर धूल में लोटतीं उत्तरेण विनिष्क्रम्य द्वारेण सह राक्षसे; । प्रविश्यायोधनं घोर विचिम्बन्त्यो हतं पतिम्‌

verses.sloka: एते सर्वे समागम्य विमानैः सूर्यसन्निभैः ।आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कामभिजग्मुश्च राघवम् ।। ६.१२०.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ete sarve samāgamya vimānaiḥ sūryasannibhaiḥ ।āgamya nagarīṁ laṅkāmabhijagmuśca rāghavam ।। 6.120.4 ।।

translations.english: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.
translations.hindi: बे सब, “ हा आयपुत्र ” ! ( यह पति के लिए सम्बोधन है ) हा नाथ ! कह कर चिल्लाती, रक्त की कीच से भरी और चिना ईसर के घढ़ों से परिपूणं समरभूमि में जाकर गिर पड़ीं

verses.sloka: ततः सहस्ताभरणान् प्रगृह्य विपुलान् भुजान् ।अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रैष्ठाः प्राञ्जलिं राघवं स्थितम् ।। ६.१२०.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sahastābharaṇān pragṛhya vipulān bhujān ।abruvaṁstridaśaśraiṣṭhāḥ prāñjaliṁ rāghavaṁ sthitam ।। 6.120.5 ।।

translations.english: Then foremost of gods adorned with ornaments in hands lifted up their long shoulders and greeted Raghava with joined palms and spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानवतां वरः ।उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्तीं हव्यवाहने ।। ६.१२०.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kartā sarvasya lokasya śreṣṭho jñānavatāṁ varaḥ ।upekṣase kathaṁ sītāṁ patantīṁ havyavāhane ।। 6.120.6 ।।

translations.english: "You are the creator of the entire world, knowledgeable and the foremost Lord of the host of gods. How did you keep watching Sita falling into fire'?
translations.hindi: उद्धत्य च श्ुजो काचिद्‌ भूमौ स्म परिवतते । हतस्य वदन दृष्टा काचित्‌ मोहपुपागमत्‌ ॥&॥ कोई अपनो दोनों भुजाएँ फैला भूमि पर लोटने लगी ओर कोई उसका मुख देख, मूच्छित हो गई

verses.sloka: कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे ।। ६.१२०.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ devagaṇaśreṣṭhamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase ।। 6.120.7 ।।

translations.english: " Among the Vasus, you are the Rtadhama and the creator of the three worlds and the first creator and selfconstituted ruler."
translations.hindi: अपने पति को रणभूमि की घूज पर पड़ा देख, वे उसके शरीर पर बैसे ही धड़ाम से गिर पड़ीं ; जैसे कटीं हुईं वनलठा धड़ाम से गिर पड़ती है

verses.sloka: ऋतधामा वसुः पूर्वं वसूनां त्वं प्रजापतिः ।त्रयाणां त्वं हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयम्प्रभुः ।रुद्राणामष्टमो रुद्रः साध्यानामसि पञ्चमः ।। ६.१२०.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṛtadhāmā vasuḥ pūrvaṁ vasūnāṁ tvaṁ prajāpatiḥ ।trayāṇāṁ tvaṁ hi lokānāmādikartā svayamprabhuḥ ।rudrāṇāmaṣṭamo rudraḥ sādhyānāmasi pañcamaḥ ।। 6.120.8 ।।

translations.english: "You are the eighth among the Rudras, fifth among the Sadhyas, two Aswins are your ears, and the sun and moon are your eyes."
translations.hindi: उनमें से कोई तो बड़े आदर के साथ उससे लिपट गई, कोई उसके पैरों से लिपट कर ओर कोई उसके कण्ठ, को पकड करः रोने लगी

verses.sloka: अश्विनौ चापि ते कर्णौ चन्द्रसूर्यौ च चक्षुषी ।अन्ते चादौ च लोकानां दृश्यसे त्वं परन्तप ।। ६.१२०.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: aśvinau cāpi te karṇau candrasūryau ca cakṣuṣī ।ante cādau ca lokānāṁ dṛśyase tvaṁ parantapa ।। 6.120.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Tormentor of enemies! You are at the beginning and at the end of the world. You are looking like a common man would look at Sita, when she was falling into pyre."

verses.transliteration: upekṣase ca vaidehīṁ mānuṣaḥ pākṛto yathā ।। 6.120.10 ।।

translations.english: Rama the upholder of dharma and foremost and supreme god spoke after the ruler of the world had spoken to him.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे कोई उसके सिर को अपनी गोद में रख और उसके मुख को देख देख कर रोने लगी ओर आसुओं की वूँदों से उसका मुख ऐसे भिगोने लगी जैसे तुषार की बूं दें कमल को भिगोती हैं

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः ।अब्रवीत्रिदशश्रेष्ठान् रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ।। ६.१२०.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityukto lokapālaistaiḥ svāmī lokasya rāghavaḥ ।abravītridaśaśreṣṭhān rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.120.11 ।।

translations.english: "I am Dasharatha's son, a human and thinking to be Rama. Tell me O divine creator, from where and whence I am here."
translations.hindi: वे अपने पति को भूमि पर मरा हुआ पड़ा देख, बड़े जोर से चिल्ला कर रोने लगीं ओर बहुत विलाप करने लगीं

verses.sloka: आत्मानं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम् ।यो ऽहं यस्य यतश्चाहं भगवांस्तद् ब्रवीतु मे ।। ६.१२०.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṁ mānuṣaṁ manye rāmaṁ daśarathātmajam ।yo 'haṁ yasya yataścāhaṁ bhagavāṁstad bravītu me ।। 6.120.12 ।।

translations.english: To Kakuthsa who spoke that way, creator Brahma replied, "O Lord of truthful prowess, listen to my true submission."
translations.hindi: विलाप करती हुई बे कहने लगीं) जिसने इन्द्र और यम को युद्ध में भयभीत कर दिआ, जिसने कुबेर से पुष्पक विमान छीन लिअ

verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवन्तं काकुत्स्थं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः ।अब्रवीच्छृणु मे राम सत्यं सत्यपराक्रम ।। ६.१२०.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti bruvantaṁ kākutsthaṁ brahmā brahmavidāṁ varaḥ ।abravīcchṛṇu me rāma satyaṁ satyaparākrama ।। 6.120.13 ।।

translations.english: "You are the divine self, glorious Narayana himself, wielder of discus. You are having a single tusk and a divine boar, knower of past and present."

verses.sloka: भवान्नारायणो देवः श्रीमांश्चक्रायुधो विभुः ।एकशृङ्गो वराहस्त्वं भूतभव्यसपत्नजित् ।। ६.१२०.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhavānnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrīmāṁścakrāyudho vibhuḥ ।ekaśṛṅgo varāhastvaṁ bhūtabhavyasapatnajit ।। 6.120.14 ।।

translations.english: "You are the imperishable Brahma in the midst or end, abiding in truth. You are dharma, all pervading four shouldered Vishnu in the world."
translations.hindi: हाय ! जो आज तक न तो कभी देवताओं से र रों से 'और न चागों से भयभीत हुआ था ; उसे आज मनु यो से - भीत होना पड़ा है

verses.sloka: अक्षरं ब्रह्म सत्यं च मध्ये चान्ते च राघव ।लोकानां त्वं परो धर्मो विष्वक्सेनश्चतुर्भुजः ।। ६.१२०.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: akṣaraṁ brahma satyaṁ ca madhye cānte ca rāghava ।lokānāṁ tvaṁ paro dharmo viṣvaksenaścaturbhujaḥ ।। 6.120.15 ।।

translations.english: "You are the wielder of Sarang bow, subduer of enemies, a supreme person, never faced defeat, wielder of sword, Vishnu, Krishna also and mighty."
translations.hindi: जो देवताओं, दानवों ओर राक्षसों से अवध्य था; वह आज एक पैदल मनुष्य के हाथ से मारा जा कर, लड़ाई के मैदान में सो रहा है

verses.sloka: शार्ङ्गधन्वा हृषीकेशः पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमः ।अजितः खड्गधृद्विष्णुः कृष्णश्चैव बृहद्बलः ।। ६.१२०.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śārṅgadhanvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।ajitaḥ khaḍgadhṛdviṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaścaiva bṛhadbalaḥ ।। 6.120.16 ।।

translations.english: "You are the Karthikeya, the commander of army, village headman. You are the intellect, forbearance. You are the origin and end also. You are Vamana and destroyer of demon Madhu."
translations.hindi: जिसे आज तक देवता, यक्ष और दैत्य नहीं मार सके थे वह एक साधारण प्राणी की तरह, एक मनुष्य के हाथ से मारा गया

verses.sloka: सेनानीर्ग्रामणीश्च त्वं बुद्धिः सत्त्वं क्षमा दमः ।प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्च त्वमुपेन्द्रो मधुसूदनः ।। ६.१२०.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: senānīrgrāmaṇīśca tvaṁ buddhiḥ sattvaṁ kṣamā damaḥ ।prabhavaścāpyayaśca tvamupendro madhusūdanaḥ ।। 6.120.17 ।।

translations.english: "You are spoken of as the creator of Indra, Mahendra himself, Padmanabha, who puts an end to combat. You are a wonderful great sage and refuge of seekers."
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार बिविध प्रकार से विलाप करती हुई वे राक्षसियाँ अत्यन्त दुखी हो, रो रही थीं । फिर वे दुःख से पीड़ित हो विलाप करती हुई कहने लगीं

verses.sloka: इन्द्रकर्मा महेन्द्रस्त्वं पद्मनाभो रणान्तकृत् ।शरण्यं शरणं च त्वामाहुर्दिव्या महर्षयः ।। ६.१२०.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: indrakarmā mahendrastvaṁ padmanābho raṇāntakṛt ।śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ ca tvāmāhurdivyā maharṣayaḥ ।। 6.120.18 ।।

translations.english: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

verses.sloka: सहस्रशृङ्गो वेदात्मा शतजिह्वो महर्षभः ।। ६.१२०.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sahasraśṛṅgo vedātmā śatajihvo maharṣabhaḥ ।। 6.120.19 ।।

translations.english: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

verses.sloka: त्वं त्रयाणां हि लोकानामादिकर्ता स्वयम्प्रभुः ।सिद्धानामपि साध्यानामाश्रयश्चासि पूर्वजः ।। ६.१२०.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ trayāṇāṁ hi lokānāmādikartā svayamprabhuḥ ।siddhānāmapi sādhyānāmāśrayaścāsi pūrvajaḥ ।। 6.120.20 ।।

translations.english: "You are the form of sacrifice ritual you are worshipped by Vasat. You are the syllable OM. Only the highest of the higher know you. You are without a beginning or end. Who you are is not known to Vedas also?"
translations.hindi: पर तुमने भ्रम में पड़, मरने के लिए ही इप्रसे कठोर वचन कह, उसे निकाल दिआ | याद विभीषण के कथनाचुसार तुमने राम को सीता लौटा दी होती

verses.sloka: त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोङ्कारः परन्तपः ।प्रभवं निधनं वा ते न विदुः को भवानिति ।। ६.१२०.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ yajñastvaṁ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṅkāraḥ parantapaḥ ।prabhavaṁ nidhanaṁ vā te na viduḥ ko bhavāniti ।। 6.120.21 ।।

translations.english: "You are seen in cows and brahmanas. You exist in all quarters, in the sky, mountains and rivers."
translations.hindi: तो हमें जड़ से नष्ट करने वाली यह घोर विपत्ति हमारे ऊपर क्यों पड़ती ! ( प्रत्युत उसके कृथनानुरूर चलने से ) तुम्हारे भाई का कहना भी रह जाता और श्रीरामचन्द्र भी तुम्हारे मित्र हो जाते

verses.sloka: दृश्यसे सर्वभूतेषु ब्राह्मणेषु च गोषु च ।दिक्षु सर्वासु गगने पर्वतेषु वनेषु च ।। ६.१२०.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛśyase sarvabhūteṣu brāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca ।dikṣu sarvāsu gagane parvateṣu vaneṣu ca ।। 6.120.22 ।।

translations.english: "You are endowed with thousand feet, glorious, with hundred heads and hundred eyes, you sustain all beings, mountains and earth."
translations.hindi: तथा न हम सब विधबाए होतीं ओर न शत्रुओं का मनोरथ ही पूरा होता । किन्तु तुमने तो निष्ठुरतापूचेक बलात्‌ सीता को अपने घर में बेंड रक्खा

verses.sloka: सहस्रचरणः श्रीमान् शतशीर्षः सहस्रदृक् ।त्वं धारयसि भूतानि वसुधां च सपर्वताम् ।। ६.१२०.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān śataśīrṣaḥ sahasradṛk ।tvaṁ dhārayasi bhūtāni vasudhāṁ ca saparvatām ।। 6.120.23 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, at the dissolution of the earth you are seen to live on water and sustain a huge serpent. You are supporting the three worlds, the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas."

verses.sloka: अन्ते पृथिव्याः सलिले दृश्यसे त्वं महोरगः ।त्रील्लोँकान् धारयन् राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान् ।। ६.१२०.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ante pṛthivyāḥ salile dṛśyase tvaṁ mahoragaḥ ।trīllom̐kān dhārayan rāma devagandharvadānavān ।। 6.120.24 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, all gods constitute your heart, Devi Saraswathi is your tongue, the gods created by Brahma are the hair on your limbs."
translations.hindi: यह सब देव की करतूत हे देव भी मरे हुए को मारता है । हे महाबाहो ! इस महासमर में वानरों का, राक्षसों का और तुम्हरा सव नाश दैवयोग ही से हुआ है । क्योंकि देवगति ऐसी है कि, वह धन से, चाहने से, पुरुषाथ से अथवा आज्ञा से करिसी के टाले नहीं टल सकती

verses.sloka: अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती ।देवा गात्रेषु रोमाणि निर्मिता ब्रह्मणः प्रभो ।। ६.१२०.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ te hṛdayaṁ rāma jihvā devī sarasvatī ।devā gātreṣu romāṇi nirmitā brahmaṇaḥ prabho ।। 6.120.25 ।।

translations.english: "When you close your eyelids, it becomes night and when you open it becomes day. Your perfection in action are the Vedas. Without you, there is nothing."

verses.sloka: निमेषस्ते भवेद्रात्रिरुन्मेषस्ते भवेद्दिवा ।संस्कारास्ते ऽभवन् वेदा न तदस्ति त्वया विना ।। ६.१२०.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: nimeṣaste bhavedrātrirunmeṣaste bhaveddivā ।saṁskārāste 'bhavan vedā na tadasti tvayā vinā ।। 6.120.26 ।।

translations.english: "The total world represents your body, your firmness represents the earth, your anger is fire, your grace is nobility, a sign of Srivatsa."
translations.hindi: इति त्रयं द्‌शोत्तरशततमः संगः || वे राक्षतराज को रानियाँ दुःख से पीडित हो, दीनभाव से आँखों में आँसू भर कर कुररी पक्षियों की तरह रोने लगीं

verses.sloka: जगत् सर्वं शरीरं ते स्थैर्यं ते वसुधातलम् ।अग्निः कोपः प्रसादस्ते सोमः श्रीवत्सलक्षणः ।। ६.१२०.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: jagat sarvaṁ śarīraṁ te sthairyaṁ te vasudhātalam ।agniḥ kopaḥ prasādaste somaḥ śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.120.27 ।।

translations.english: "Before you took the form of Trivikrama, and took three strides, occupied the three worlds and bound the dreadful king Bali you made Mahendra as king of heaven."

verses.sloka: त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुराणे विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः ।महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा महासुरम् ।। ६.१२०.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā lokāstrayaḥ krāntāḥ purāṇe vikramaistribhiḥ ।mahendraśca kṛto rājā baliṁ baddhvā mahāsuram ।। 6.120.28 ।।

translations.english: "Sita is goddess Lakshmi while you are Vishnu. You are Krishna. You are the Lord of created beings. In order to put an end to Ravana, you entered the mortal body on earth."

verses.sloka: सीता लक्ष्मीर्भवान् विष्णुर्देवः कृष्णः प्रजापतिः ।वधार्थं रावणस्येह प्रविष्टो मानुषीं तनुम् ।। ६.१२०.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sītā lakṣmīrbhavān viṣṇurdevaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।vadhārthaṁ rāvaṇasyeha praviṣṭo mānuṣīṁ tanum ।। 6.120.29 ।।

translations.english: "Rama you are the supreme and upholder of dharma. The purpose for which you are born has been accomplished. Ravana is killed. You return to your abode happily."

verses.sloka: तदिदं नः कृतं कार्यं त्वया धर्मभृतां वर ।निहतो रावणो राम प्रहृष्टो दिवमाक्रम ।। ६.१२०.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: tadidaṁ naḥ kṛtaṁ kāryaṁ tvayā dharmabhṛtāṁ vara ।nihato rāvaṇo rāma prahṛṣṭo divamākrama ।। 6.120.30 ।।

translations.english: "O God! Your valour is wonderful, your prowess never goes in vain. Your sight is a blessing, and your praise is unfailing and not gone in vain."

verses.sloka: अमोघं बलवीर्यं ते अमोघस्ते पराक्रमः ।अमोघं दर्शनं राम न च मोघः स्तवस्तव ।। ६.१२०.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: amoghaṁ balavīryaṁ te amoghaste parākramaḥ ।amoghaṁ darśanaṁ rāma na ca moghaḥ stavastava ।। 6.120.31 ।।

translations.english: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."

verses.sloka: अमोघास्ते भविष्यन्ति भक्तिमन्तश्च ये नराः ।। ६.१२०.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: amoghāste bhaviṣyanti bhaktimantaśca ye narāḥ ।। 6.120.32 ।।

translations.english: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."

verses.sloka: ये त्वां देवं ध्रुवं भक्ताः पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् ।प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा कामानिह लोके परत्र च ।। ६.१२०.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ye tvāṁ devaṁ dhruvaṁ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṁ puruṣottamam ।prāpnuvanti sadā kāmāniha loke paratra ca ।। 6.120.33 ।।

translations.english: 'Those men who shall recite this holy, divine and ancient hymn of praise, this ancient narrative, shall never know defeat.'

verses.sloka: इममार्षं स्तवं नित्यमितिहासं पुरातनम् ।ये नराः कीर्तयिष्यन्ति नास्ति तेषां पराभवः ।। ६.१२०.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: imamārṣaṁ stavaṁ nityamitihāsaṁ purātanam ।ye narāḥ kīrtayiṣyanti nāsti teṣāṁ parābhavaḥ ।। 6.120.34 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे विंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२० ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe viṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 120 ।।
